applicability: GUM-style combined and expanded measurement uncertainty from declared independent standard-uncertainty components
assumptions: each declared uncertainty component is already expressed as a standard uncertainty, not already expanded
the components are independent random variables combined in quadrature
a coverage factor of k=2 approximates 95% coverage for a normal distribution
excluded: Type A vs Type B decomposition
empirical gage R&R or interlaboratory comparison validation
uncertainty: Standard textbook metrology (GUM); hand-verified before use (components [0.1,0.2,0.05], k=2 -> uc=0.229128..., U=0.458257...).
limits_policy: Expanded uncertainty exceeding the declared budget is flagged rather than accepted.
